prompt: A photorealistic wide frame of a draughty church-hall community room, taken from a lens bolted high in one corner near the ceiling and angled down, so the people are small and seen from above. Brandon sits on a stacked-plastic folding chair in the lower left third, leaning over his phone with his brows lifted, his eyelids wide and the corners of his mouth pulled up, his eyes aimed at the phone in his hands; the phone's face is turned away from the lens and shows only a pale smear of light on his chin. Behind him, three campaigners in anoraks and jumpers lean over a trestle table covered in paper cups and loose leaflets, one reaching for a roll of masking tape. The only light is a row of buzzing fluorescent tubes on the ceiling and a grey daylight smear through a high frosted window, so the colours are washed out and slightly green, with soft compression blocks, fine night-mode noise and slightly blown highlights near the window. Shot on a cheap fixed wide-angle sensor with a little barrel distortion, nothing in frame carries any writing. Thanks.
